fields.summary_ko.0: SPCX +3.62%, with CEO Musk suggesting potential achievement of $500B–$1T annual recurring revenue (ARR) by end of 2027.
fields.summary_ko.1: If $1T ARR is achieved, a 10x revenue multiple valuation would yield a market cap of $10T, implying a stock price of $736 from the current $138.
fields.summary_ko.2: Q3 SI segment grew 830% YoY to $7.56B, though achieving $1T ARR target would require Q4 2027 quarterly recurring revenue of $250B, which appears unlikely.
